requirement: Pre-await execution and post-resumption hits are distinguished

obligations.note: Suspension point. A provider must attribute this line as reached once, at the point of suspension, not skipped or double-counted at resumption.

notes: Uses a custom signal (resume_now) rather than a scene-tree frame signal (e.g. process_frame), deferred-emitted so the suspend/resume genuinely crosses an idle-frame boundary without needing multi-frame driving logic in the driver. This isolates the core risk -- can a line-injecting collector correctly attribute code before an await, the await statement itself, and code after resumption, without merging or losing any of the three -- without conflating it with scene-tree frame timing. If BP04 finds gd-tools' counter injection behaves differently for a get_tree().process_frame-based await, that is a distinct follow-up fixture, not assumed to be covered by this one.
author: godot-tooling-session-2026-09-19
ambiguities: F046 (await never resumes) is a separate tier-1 case and deliberately not covered here.
